messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a p95 latency spike on the embeddings endpoint when mixed-dim payloads are split across shards. looks like KV cache churn after splitting, not model perf.

maya: saw this on canary too. small 1-4 vector requests that get split end up on cold shards. throughput looks fine but tail latency jumps.

sam: what splitter strategy are we using? byte-slices or dim-slot? current default tries to maximize GPU packing, which can ignore tenant affinity.

talia: thought: add a shape-aware affinity preference. keep vectors from the same tenant/sub-request together if it meaningfully reduces cache misses. tradeoff = worse packing (cost) vs lower p95.

chris: can we expose that as a console toggle per-route? eg "prefer_affinity" vs "prefer_throughput" with an estimated cost/latency preview. Enterprise customers would want affinity.

alex: telemetry we need to validate: per-split p50/p95, shard_kv_cache_hit_rate, shard_warmups_per_min, per-tenant slowtail_rate, and network_copy_bytes. also show expected token-cost delta when preferring affinity.

maya: simple algo sketch I prototyped:
```
# pseudo
def choose_split(batch):
  if batch.tenant_id and affinity_score(batch) > 0.7 and batch.fill_fraction > 0.6:
    return keep_together(batch)
  else:
    return split_by_bytes(batch)
```

sam: I'd add an adaptive cooldown: if warmups_per_min > threshold then bias to affinity for next N windows. avoids flip-flopping during bursts.

ingress-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout embed-splitter/v2 at 10% started at 6375112305.

talia: UX notes for console: show an "estimated impact" panel before toggling: cost delta, estimated p95 delta (based on recent telemetry), and sample trace links. tooltip: "Affinity keeps KV hot — best for low-latency small tenants"

alex: runbook draft: 1) enable canary 10% + new telemetry tiles 2) run 24h automated A/B collecting p95, cache_hit 3) if p95 improves >5% for target tenants, expand 50% 4) rollback if p95 regresses >10% or cost >10% 5) GA with console toggle and default off for hosted. assigning @maya to dashboard, @sam to splitter config flags. :thumbsup:

maya: adding dashboard tiles and alert: if route p95 increases >10% after a toggle we auto-rollback. will also track per-tenant delta so we can recommend affinity for specific tenants.

chris: nit — we should make the affinity threshold tunable via API and show historical "affinity wins" stats in console so SREs can make informed decisions.

alex: thanks — I'll spin up the PR for the config flag and the runbook. tagging followups in docs channel once PR is up.
